question:
The following pie chart shows the number of cups sold by each of 7 different shops during a given period of time as percentages of the total number of cups sold by these 7 shops taken together during the above-mentioned time period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35337faa4862c7ea8fe44bf76928396cc16cb6656633011a96a7f119b2ba9fae.png] 

If the number of cups sold by S6 during this period is 165, then how many cups in total are sold during this period by all these 7 shops taken together?
solution:
Calculation:

The number of cups sold by S6 during this period is 165 means 7.5% of the pie chart represents 165 cups.
